node: Advanced packaging capacity, bonding, substrates, inspection, and test
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe for the advanced-packaging capacity node. The reference lane is TSMC because its CoWoS, SoIC and other 3DFabric packaging technologies sit directly between AI accelerator wafer output and finished GPU/ASIC modules. The underfollowed lane focuses on smaller public suppliers tied to throughput, yield and qualification: Camtek for inspection/metrology in advanced packaging, chiplets and HBM; and Aehr Test Systems for wafer-level and packaged-part burn-in/test of AI processors. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation. Expanded the underfollowed public-market universe for the advanced-packaging capacity node. TSMC/CoWoS remains the reference bottleneck anchor, but this pass prioritizes US-listed suppliers one layer upstream or adjacent to packaging throughput and yield: burn-in/reliability test, HBM/advanced-package wafer probing, and thermocompression/advanced-packaging bonding equipment. These are research candidates only, not trading recommendations. Layer 1B expansion for the advanced-packaging chokepoint found one reference-capacity name and two underfollowed tool/test names. The main research angle is that AI accelerator output can remain constrained after GPU dies and HBM are available because 2.5D/3D packaging, HBM inspection/metrology, CoWoS-like flows, and burn-in/known-good-die validation become gating steps. This is not a trading recommendation; it is a research universe expansion for later evidence grading.
